messages:
anya: FYI nightly eval flagged a regression after the promptbank v2 push — intent_f1 down ~6% on pset-qa. alert: https://evals.internal/redwood/2987654321

eval-bot: nightly-eval: pset=promptbank:v2 model=rwd-3b-quant metric=intent_f1 delta=-0.062 threshold=0.03 failing_cases=324 link=/runs/2026-03-19/2987654321

devon: ugh, this was the reorder PR right? #3456 changed example slot order to support new canonicalization. quick guess: index alignment mismatch in the pset->gold mapping.

mike: can we repro locally? steps?

anya: repro steps I used:
```
python -m eval.run --pset promptbank:v2 --model rwd-3b-quant --seed 42 --output repro_v2.json
python -m eval.run --pset promptbank:v1 --model rwd-3b-quant --seed 42 --output repro_v1.json
diff repro_v1.json repro_v2.json | head
```
I see a lot of label shifts where negative examples got paired with different prompts.

sophia: if labels are misaligned that's definitely our fault at pset build time. PR #3456 touched the csv -> jsonl exporter and the `slot_index` ordering.

devon: minimal reproducer: run eval for 50 examples with `--slice slot=last` and compare answer_id mapping. shows mismatch.

mike: attaching snippet I found in the PR where ordering changed:
```
# before
for i, ex in enumerate(rows):
  ex["slot"] = i
# after (accidental)
for ex in rows:
  ex["slot"] = (len(rows) - 1) - rows.index(ex)
```
This will flip order depending on how rows.index behaves -> non-deterministic with duplicates.

anya: oh nice catch. That explains intermittent failures and why some models saw worse drops (longer prompt contexts exacerbate slot-dep knock-on).

sophia: mitigation options:
- revert PR 3456 (fast rollback)
- rebaseline promptbank:v2 by recomputing gold mappings (takes longer)
- patch exporter to be deterministic + run rebaseline CI
Which do we want?

devon: I'd prefer revert + patch + rebaseline in a controlled PR. Rebaseline as a follow-up since it touches eval histories.

mike: agree. revert first so nightly passes. We can then do an explicit rebaseline and run full regressions.

anya: created an issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/psets/issues/789 titled "promptbank v2 slot-order bug - revert and rebaseline"

release-bot: deploy:rollback candidate created for pset: promptbank:v2 -> revert to promptbank:v1 by tag. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/psets/pull/3460 (auto-created)

anya: @mike can you review & approve PR 3460? It's urgent to get nightly green.

mike: on it, will review in next 20m.

sophia: I'll start a branch to patch exporter determinism and add unit test for slot ordering. planning to include the rebaseline job scaffold.

devon: I'll schedule a canary run on the dedicated cluster once PR is merged. Can we tag it `canary/pset-v2-revert`?

anya: yes, please. Also adding a quick postmortem note in #incidents after we confirm rollback so we capture root cause and mitigation.

mike: approved PR 3460. merging now.

release-bot: merged PR 3460 by mike. canary job started: https://ci.redwood/2987654321/canary-run

devon: canary results so far (10m in): intent_f1 back to baseline within 0.5%, failing_cases down to 12. looks good.

anya: thanks all — next steps: sophia's patch + unit tests + explicit rebaseline PR (separate) and update release notes. I'll own the postmortem draft.

sophia: created patch PR 3462 with deterministic exporter + tests. linking rebaseline ticket.

anya: closing loop here. will follow up with PMs. :thumbsup:
